title: Ichigenme... The First Class is Civil Law
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: At an elite university, studious, not-rich law student Tamiya joins the 'easiest' seminar and is kissed at a welcome party by Tohdou, a showy playboy and son of a powerful politician. Their unlikely friendship becomes a romance as graduation nears. Volume two jumps ahead: Tamiya becomes a professor, and Tohdou's brother has an affair with an insecure law teacher.
life_message: Love can grow between people of very different values if each takes the other seriously.
